## Frequently asked questions

### What is PayPal Braintree?

PayPal Braintree is a global payment processing solution that delivers end-to-end checkout
experiences for businesses, offering single-touch payments, mobile SDKs, and global currency
acceptance for seamless transactions.

### What are the accepted PayPal Braintree payment methods?

PayPal Braintree supports [PayPal][23] payments, [Venmo][24] (in the US), credit and debit cards,
popular digital wallets like Apple Pay and Google Pay, as well as local payment methods. [Learn more
about payment methods][25].

### Where can I log in to my Braintree account?

Using your established Braintree login username and password, you can [access your Braintree Control
Panel here][26]. If you have corporate domain credentials, you can [use single sign on to log
in][27].

### Is PayPal Braintree PCI compliant?

PayPal Braintree is a validated Level 1 PCI DSS compliant service provider and offers a secure
checkout experience with ready-built payment interfaces that meet SAQ-A PCI compliance validation
requirements. [Learn more about PCI compliance][28].

### What are the capabilities of the PayPal Braintree Sandbox?

Our [sandbox][29] lets you test and get a feel for the PayPal Braintree experience before you apply.
* Try our payment processing platform with no obligation to apply for a PayPal Braintree account
* Explore the control panel, reporting tools, and features
* Run sample test transactions, play with subscriptions, and fully test the API

We’re here to help your business grow, compete, and thrive in today’s digital commerce landscape.

## Le funzionalità di Fatture in Cloud

### Fatturazione Elettronica veloce

Gestione pagamenti

**Ricevi pagamenti dai clienti**, emetti bonifici ai fornitori ed esegui la riconciliazione
bancaria, **in un unico software** e direttamente dalle fatture elettroniche. Lo scadenzario ti
avvisa prima che una scadenza diventi un problema.
* Pagamenti con carta, addebito, bonifico e PayPal
* Riconciliazione bancaria con AI
* Prima nota e solleciti di pagamento

Compila il preventivo e il cliente lo approva. **Con pochi clic il preventivo diventa fattura**,

[ Vai ai preventivi ][46]


### App mobile

Fatturazione elettronica, pagamenti e situazione della tua attività **sempre con te**. Funziona su
smartphone e tablet.

[ Vai all'app mobile ][47]

Smetti di aspettare il commercialista per sapere se stai guadagnando. Fatturato, costi e IVA **sono
sempre sotto controllo, in tempo reale**.
[ Vai a Analisi e Report ][48]

allegati, niente attese.
[ Vai a Commercialista connesso ][49]


### Magazzino

**Carico e scarico aggiornati** a ogni fattura e acquisto. Sai sempre cosa hai, senza contare a
mano.
[ Vai alla Gestione Magazzino ][50]


### Acquisti

Le fatture elettroniche passive sono registrate in automatico e categorizzate. **Mantieni tutte le
spese tracciate** e prendi decisioni più consapevoli.

## Prova Fatture in Cloud gratis

Prova le funzionalità di Fatture in Cloud e poi decidi senza impegno se acquistare una licenza.

30 giorni di prova gratuita
* Compila fatture e documenti
* Prova la gestione dei pagamenti
* Collega il tuo commercialista

[Prova gratis ][58]

[Registrati gratis*][59] senza obbligo d’acquisto

## Domande frequenti su Fatture in Cloud

### Posso importare i dati dal mio vecchio gestionale?

Sì. Puoi importare fatture elettroniche, documenti e anagrafiche di clienti e fornitori dal tuo
vecchio software. Durante l’importazione puoi continuare a lavorare normalmente, emettere e ricevere
fatture, creare documenti e usare tutte le funzionalità di Fatture in Cloud. La procedura è
ulteriormente semplificata per chi proviene da altri software TeamSystem come Fattura Smart e
Easyfatt.

### Da quali gestionali posso passare a Fatture in Cloud?

Puoi passare a Fatture in Cloud da tutti i software di fatturazione elettronica, purché consentano
di scaricare lo storico dei documenti elettronici.

### Cosa succede dopo la prova gratuita di Fatture in Cloud?

Al termine della prova gratuita puoi decidere senza impegno se acquistare una licenza Fatture in
Cloud.

### Cosa è incluso nel piano da 4€/mese?

Il piano da 4€ al mese è riservato agli utenti che si trovano in Regime Forfettario. Include le
funzionalità della Licenza Standard e altre pensate appositamente per i forfettari: inserimento
automatico di alcuni campi (regime fiscale, aliquota IVA 0% e imposta di bollo per importi superiori
ai 77,47€), monitoraggio in tempo reale del limite di fatturato e stima delle tasse da versare.

### La conservazione sostitutiva è inclusa?

Sì. La conservazione sostitutiva delle fatture elettroniche è inclusa e garantita per 10 anni a
norma di legge.

### Il mio commercialista deve pagare per accedere?

No, il tuo commercialista può supportarti nella gestione della fatturazione elettronica, dei costi e
di tutta la tua attività senza pagare nulla.

### Come funziona l’assistenza di Fatture in Cloud?

Puoi contattare il team di assistenza di Fatture in Cloud tramite la chat disponibile all’interno
della piattaforma, sia da web sia da app. L’assistenza gratuita include supporto per domande
sull’utilizzo del software, risoluzione di problemi tecnici di base, diagnosi iniziale di eventuali
malfunzionamenti, accesso alla manuale online.

### Posso usare Fatture in Cloud da più dispositivi?

Fatture in Cloud è accessibile direttamente da browser e non richiede requisiti specifici sul PC.
Tramite l’App mobile, è possibile utilizzare il programma da smartphone e tablet.

*Prova gratuita – Nessun impegno, nessun addebito:
* L’adesione alla prova gratuita non dà luogo all’attivazione di alcun abbonamento
* Nessun dato di pagamento è richiesto per attivare la prova gratuita
* Al termine del periodo di prova gratuita il servizio cessa senza necessità di alcuna
  disattivazione o altra azione
* Al termine del periodo di prova gratuita potrai scegliere se acquistare l’abbonamento ad un piano
  solo su tua esplicita richiesta
* La prova gratuita è identica per tutti i piani: se vorrai attivare il servizio a pagamento, potrai
  scegliere il piano più adatto a te al termine del periodo di prova gratuita
* La prova gratuita è disponibile una sola volta per ciascun utente
* L’acquisto al termine della prova gratuita comporterà, oltre al prezzo annuale di abbonamento,
  l’applicazione di una addizionale per costi di gestione amministrativa 1,00 € + IVA (carta/PayPal)
  oppure 2,50 € + IVA (bonifico) , addebitata una sola volta per ciascun pagamento.

## Domande frequenti su Fatture in Cloud

### Posso importare i dati dal mio vecchio gestionale?

Sì. Puoi importare fatture elettroniche, documenti e anagrafiche di clienti e fornitori dal tuo
vecchio software. Durante l’importazione puoi continuare a lavorare normalmente, emettere e ricevere
fatture, creare documenti e usare tutte le funzionalità di Fatture in Cloud. La procedura è
ulteriormente semplificata per chi proviene da altri software TeamSystem come Fattura Smart e
Easyfatt.

### Da quali gestionali posso passare a Fatture in Cloud?

Puoi passare a Fatture in Cloud da tutti i software di fatturazione elettronica, purché consentano
di scaricare lo storico dei documenti elettronici.

### Cosa succede dopo la prova gratuita di Fatture in Cloud?

Al termine della prova gratuita puoi decidere senza impegno se acquistare una licenza Fatture in
Cloud.

### Cosa è incluso nel piano da 4€/mese?

Il piano da 4€ al mese è riservato agli utenti che si trovano in Regime Forfettario. Include le
funzionalità della Licenza Standard e altre pensate appositamente per i forfettari: inserimento
automatico di alcuni campi (regime fiscale, aliquota IVA 0% e imposta di bollo per importi superiori
ai 77,47€), monitoraggio in tempo reale del limite di fatturato e stima delle tasse da versare.

### La conservazione sostitutiva è inclusa?

Sì. La conservazione sostitutiva delle fatture elettroniche è inclusa e garantita per 10 anni a
norma di legge.

### Il mio commercialista deve pagare per accedere?

No, il tuo commercialista può supportarti nella gestione della fatturazione elettronica, dei costi e
di tutta la tua attività senza pagare nulla.

### Come funziona l’assistenza di Fatture in Cloud?

Puoi contattare il team di assistenza di Fatture in Cloud tramite la chat disponibile all’interno
della piattaforma, sia da web sia da app. L’assistenza gratuita include supporto per domande
sull’utilizzo del software, risoluzione di problemi tecnici di base, diagnosi iniziale di eventuali
malfunzionamenti, accesso alla manuale online.

### Posso usare Fatture in Cloud da più dispositivi?

Fatture in Cloud è accessibile direttamente da browser e non richiede requisiti specifici sul PC.
Tramite l’App mobile, è possibile utilizzare il programma da smartphone e tablet.

* Al termine del periodo di prova gratuita il servizio cessa senza necessità di alcuna
  disattivazione o altra azione
* Al termine del periodo di prova gratuita potrai scegliere se acquistare l’abbonamento ad un piano

* La prova gratuita è identica per tutti i piani: se vorrai attivare il servizio a pagamento, potrai

# **Global payments made simple – online payment solutions for you**

The Payoneer multi-currency account has everything your business needs to pay, get paid, and grow
globally.

[Open your account][158]

#### **Trusted by millions of businesses worldwide**

[Home][Home] [Home][Home] [Home][Home] [Home][Home] [Home][Home] [Home][Home] [Home][Home]
[Home][Home]

## **All you need to grow your business globally**

BETA

### **Stablecoin Payments**

Move money when business moves. The stablecoin wallet, powered by Bridge, gives businesses access to
a faster payment rail alongside fiat, all on one platform.

[Learn more][159]
[Home][Home]

### **Commercial Cards**

Pay global expenses anywhere Mastercard® is accepted, track team spend, and set custom spending
limits.

[Learn more][160]
[Home][Home]

### **Workforce Management**

Simplify hiring, onboarding, and paying global teams across 160+ countries while staying aligned
with local compliance.

[Learn more][161]
[Home][Home]

### **Multicurrency Accounts**

Let your global clients pay you directly in multiple currencies – easy, fast, and friction-free.

[Learn more][162]
[Home][Home]

### **Pay Globally**

Send single, batch, or recurring payments worldwide, with automated scheduling that saves time.

[Learn more][163]
[Home][Home]

### **Business Funding**

Access prequalified capital – right inside Payoneer – to seize opportunities, steady cash flow, and
keep growing.

[Learn more][164]
[Home][Home]

Meet Payoneer

## **We have
## a lot to offer you**

Here’s how our global payment solutions and expertise can help you and your business.

[[Home][Home]][165]

## **Facts and stats**

Our platform’s ready to take your business global with [**Trustpilot reviews**][166] and **[App
Store ratings][167] **to prove it. Join 5 million people who already trust us to manage and move
their money around the world.

## **Millions**

**OF customers worldwide**

## **70**

**CURRENCIES SUPPORTED**

## **190+**

**countries and territories** **COVERED**

## **17**

**LANGUAGES SUPPORTED**

[More about us][168]

## **Why do business with Payoneer?**

Cross-border payments can get complicated but we’ve made it our mission to uncomplicate them.

[Home][Home]

### **Keep more of what you earn**

There are no lengthy or costly international wire transfers to think about. With Payoneer you can
get paid quickly and simply, as if you were a local.

[Home][Home]

### **Open marketplace opportunities**

With connections to all the leading marketplaces, Payoneer lets you expand global business as you
wish.

[Home][Home]

### **Join the network**

You’re part of something big – connect with millions of businesses and platforms already putting
their trust in Payoneer.

[Home][Home]

### **We’re with you at every step**

Our global teams are ready to talk everything business payments in the language of your choice.

[Home][Home]

### **Your global business wallet**

The world’s in your wallet when you can pay and get paid by anyone, anywhere. Our reach can help you
with global expansion in the digital economy.

[Home][Home]

### **Easy, fast transactions with Apple Pay**

Use your Payoneer card with Apple Pay for an easy, secure, and private way to pay — in-store,
online, and even in your favorite apps. Available with your Payoneer card on your Apple devices.

## The 2026 State of Subscriptions report

Explore the key metrics and emerging trends shaping the future of the subscription industry, backed
by insights from 76 million subscribers and the stories behind the data, including:
* **The “pause” dividend:** How top merchants drove a 337% increase in pause usage to retain
  customers who would have otherwise canceled
* **The AI-driven subscriber:** Why 43% of consumers are now comfortable with AI managing
  subscriptions, especially for fraud prevention and content personalization

Download the full report to dive deeper into the data and see what it means for your subscription
strategy.

[[icon bar chart black]See the data][22]

State of Subscriptions 2026: Key Findings

Subscription churn remains a critical challenge for recurring revenue businesses, with 52% of consum
ers canceling a subscription in the past year. Yet churn isn't always permanent — nearly 1 in 4 new 
subscription sign-ups are actually win-backs, showing that lost customers frequently return.

When subscribers do stay, three factors consistently drive retention: value for money, price, and da
ta privacy, with 88%, 86%, and 84% of subscribers respectively citing these as reasons for staying s
ubscribed.

Billing flexibility continues to shape subscriber loyalty. 78% of merchants now offer both monthly a
nd annual billing plans, giving customers more control over how they pay. Payment preferences also v
ary widely by region: in the U.S., credit and debit cards remain the dominant payment method, while 
in EMEA, digital wallets and alternative payment methods are increasingly preferred.

Artificial intelligence is also reshaping subscription management — 43% of respondents say they trus
t AI to manage their subscriptions, signaling a shift in how businesses and consumers approach billi
ng, retention, and customer experience strategy.

These trends raise an important question for subscription businesses: is your strategy keeping up? T
he full State of Subscriptions 2026 report from Recurly breaks down these findings in more detail.

## The 2026 State of Subscriptions report

Explore the key metrics and emerging trends shaping the future of the subscription industry, backed
by insights from 76 million subscribers and the stories behind the data, including:
* **The “pause” dividend:** How top merchants drove a 337% increase in pause usage to retain
  customers who would have otherwise canceled
* **The AI-driven subscriber:** Why 43% of consumers are now comfortable with AI managing
  subscriptions, especially for fraud prevention and content personalization

Download the full report to dive deeper into the data and see what it means for your subscription

[[icon bar chart black]See the data][22]

State of Subscriptions 2026: Key Findings

Subscription churn remains a critical challenge for recurring revenue businesses, with 52% of consum
ers canceling a subscription in the past year. Yet churn isn't always permanent — nearly 1 in 4 new 
subscription sign-ups are actually win-backs, showing that lost customers frequently return.

When subscribers do stay, three factors consistently drive retention: value for money, price, and da
ta privacy, with 88%, 86%, and 84% of subscribers respectively citing these as reasons for staying s
ubscribed.

Billing flexibility continues to shape subscriber loyalty. 78% of merchants now offer both monthly a
nd annual billing plans, giving customers more control over how they pay. Payment preferences also v
ary widely by region: in the U.S., credit and debit cards remain the dominant payment method, while 
in EMEA, digital wallets and alternative payment methods are increasingly preferred.

Artificial intelligence is also reshaping subscription management — 43% of respondents say they trus
t AI to manage their subscriptions, signaling a shift in how businesses and consumers approach billi
ng, retention, and customer experience strategy.

These trends raise an important question for subscription businesses: is your strategy keeping up? T
he full State of Subscriptions 2026 report from Recurly breaks down these findings in more detail.

## Frequently asked questions about Comfi

[Contact Us][67]

### What are Comfi’s approval requirements and eligibility criteria?

Comfi’s eligibility criteria are designed for growing SMEs and trading companies that need quick
access to working capital. A business must be in operation for atleast 6 months, and have an average
monthly revenue of AED 100,000.

### Is Comfi an alternative to bank loans and business loans?

Yes. Comfi is a modern alternative to bank loans and traditional business loans. With quick time to
approve, minimal paperwork, and a full-digital platform, Comfi provides fast SME financing with
flexible repayment options built for real business cash flow needs.

### What payment terms does Comfi offer?

Comfi offers flexible payment terms across 30, 60, and 90 days with 2 to 3 installments. These
payment options allow SMEs to grow without cash flow pressure while still meeting their supplier
obligations on time.

### How is Comfi different from traditional trade credit?

Unlike trade credit, which depends on supplier trust and long waiting periods, Comfi provides
immediate SME capital by converting their outstanding invoices to cash. Businesses get paid upfront
while maintaining strong supplier relationships.

### Does Comfi provide instant capital for SMEs?

Yes. Comfi provides instant capital by converting unpaid invoices into immediate cash. This helps
businesses avoid delayed payments while maintaining smooth cash flow operations.

### Are there any processing fees or service charges?

Comfi maintains transparent pricing with zero processing fees and service charges shared upfront.
There are no hidden costs, so SMEs always know exactly what they are paying for.

### What are Comfi’s approval requirements and eligibility criteria?

Comfi’s eligibility criteria are designed for growing SMEs and trading companies that need quick
access to working capital. A business must be in operation for atleast 6 months, and have an average
monthly revenue of AED 100,000.

### Is Comfi an alternative to bank loans and business loans?

Yes. Comfi is a modern alternative to bank loans and traditional business loans. With quick time to
approve, minimal paperwork, and a full-digital platform, Comfi provides fast SME financing with
flexible repayment options built for real business cash flow needs.

### What payment terms does Comfi offer?

Comfi offers flexible payment terms across 30, 60, and 90 days with 2 to 3 installments. These
payment options allow SMEs to grow without cash flow pressure while still meeting their supplier
obligations on time.

### How is Comfi different from traditional trade credit?

Unlike trade credit, which depends on supplier trust and long waiting periods, Comfi provides
immediate SME capital by converting their outstanding invoices to cash. Businesses get paid upfront
while maintaining strong supplier relationships.

### Does Comfi provide instant capital for SMEs?

Yes. Comfi provides instant capital by converting unpaid invoices into immediate cash. This helps
businesses avoid delayed payments while maintaining smooth cash flow operations.

### Are there any processing fees or service charges?

Comfi maintains transparent pricing with zero processing fees and service charges shared upfront.
There are no hidden costs, so SMEs always know exactly what they are paying for.

### Faster eco-investment infrastructure

Partnering with ConnectPay transformed our entire financial infrastructure and unlocked growth
opportunities we couldn’t achieve before. What impressed us most was how seamlessly the transition
happened – over 15,000 users moved to individual IBAN accounts with 90% onboarding automatically in
just seconds, all while maintaining complete front-end continuity.

### Seamless embedded lending infrastructure

Embedded lending services are all about user convenience. The whole idea is about creating
opportunities for small and medium-sized merchants to access working capital through the platforms
they already use in their business. Cooperation with ConnectPay is crucial in creating smooth
processes and great customer experiences for both our partners and their business customers.

— Audrius Griškevičius, CEO and Co-Founder at Softloans

[bemybond logo]

### Scaling bond investments

We are glad to have worked with ConnectPay on our platform as they did their best to tailor their
existing solutions to suit our needs and technical requirements. Despite challenging communication
and tight deadlines towards the end of the project, together we managed to create a seamless and
easy payment solution for the majority of our clients, which was one of our main goals and we
consider it a great success.

— Indrė Dargytė, CEO at BeMyBond

beyond, or are based outside the EEA and want to reach clients within it, we probably have the right

## Trusted by fast-growing platforms across Europe

Real stories from companies scaling through our seamless payments.

[InSoil logo]

### Faster eco-investment infrastructure

Partnering with ConnectPay transformed our entire financial infrastructure and unlocked growth
opportunities we couldn’t achieve before. What impressed us most was how seamlessly the transition
happened – over 15,000 users moved to individual IBAN accounts with 90% onboarding automatically in
just seconds, all while maintaining complete front-end continuity.

— Laimonas Noreika, CEO at InSoil

[SL logotipas original]

### Seamless embedded lending infrastructure

Embedded lending services are all about user convenience. The whole idea is about creating
opportunities for small and medium-sized merchants to access working capital through the platforms
they already use in their business. Cooperation with ConnectPay is crucial in creating smooth
processes and great customer experiences for both our partners and their business customers.

— Audrius Griškevičius, CEO and Co-Founder at Softloans

[bemybond logo]

### Scaling bond investments

We are glad to have worked with ConnectPay on our platform as they did their best to tailor their
existing solutions to suit our needs and technical requirements. Despite challenging communication
and tight deadlines towards the end of the project, together we managed to create a seamless and
easy payment solution for the majority of our clients, which was one of our main goals and we
consider it a great success.

— Indrė Dargytė, CEO at BeMyBond

Why should I choose GETTRX?
GETTRX offers transparent billing and competitive rates, all backed by the industry's best customer

when we started the company over thirty years ago. Our highly skilled specialists take the time to

What is a Merchant Account?

business operations by handling the responsibility of maintaining your processed payments within the
federal/state regulations and depositing funds into your bank account. All backed by our industry

in-person, online, or needs the capability to split a transaction amongst accounts for your

applications with all the required documents. In special cases we can have any type of business

Why should I choose GETTRX?
GETTRX offers transparent billing and competitive rates, all backed by the industry's best customer

when we started the company over thirty years ago. Our highly skilled specialists take the time to

your needs and help you scale.
What is a Merchant Account?
A merchant account allows your business to accept credit and debit card payments in exchange for
your product or service. GETTRX, as an acting Merchant Service Provider (MSP), assists you in your
business operations by handling the responsibility of maintaining your processed payments within the
federal/state regulations and depositing funds into your bank account. All backed by our industry
leading customer service and hands-on risk protection departments.

in-person, online, or needs the capability to split a transaction amongst accounts for your
software, we have the right solution for you. GETTRX serves both low risk and high risk merchants.

market changes as your business demands.

##### Seamless end-to-end

exceptional performance through higher authorization rates, and industry-leading uptime.

##### Industry-leading

#### **Businesses like yours trust us with billions of secure transactions each year****–over 66
#### billion, in fact**

Security is fundamental. We use progressive layers of infrastructure to provide defense in depth.
Our fully compliant 3D Secure 2 authentication technology helps reduce fraud, increases conversions,
and helps keep customers' data safe. As attested by third-party auditors, we meet the toughest
industry-specific compliance standards, and can easily tailor rules to your business and local
regulations.

## Financial infrastructure for platforms, fintechs, and banks building the future of money.

### Build financial products your customers love while transforming your financial operations into a
### competitive advantage. Deploy enterprise-grade stablecoin infrastructure with Mural Pay—launch

OUR PLATFORM
* ### **Store**
  
  **Keep funds secure in multiple currencies, including stablecoins, all in one place. Mural Pay
  gives you full control over your balances with instant access whenever you need to move money.**
* ### **Send**
  
  **Move money across borders to anyone, anywhere, in their preferred currency. Mural Pay
  streamlines every transfer with real-time tracking and fast settlement, so your recipients get
  paid without the wait.**
* ### **Receive**
  
  **Accept payments from anywhere in the world with dedicated accounts. Mural Pay handles routing
  and FX complexity so funds land in your account ready to use. Seamlessly accept stablecoins now.**
* ### **Convert**
  
  **Swap between currencies at market-leading rates with full transparency. Mural Pay shows you
  exactly what you're getting before you confirm, without hidden fees.**
* ### **Earn**
  
  **Put idle balances to work. Mural Pay lets you generate yield on stored funds, turning dormant
  cash into passive income.**
* ### **Comply**
  
  **Enable global financial workflows without having to acquire licensing or build your own
  compliance program. Mural Pay automates compliance checks and regulatory reporting so you can
  focus on growing your business.**

WHAT WE do

## Financial infrastructure for platforms, fintechs, and banks building the future of money.

### Build financial products your customers love while transforming your financial operations into a
### competitive advantage. Deploy enterprise-grade stablecoin infrastructure with Mural Pay—launch
### accounts, wallets, and payments in weeks.

OUR PLATFORM
* ### **Store**
  
  **Keep funds secure in multiple currencies, including stablecoins, all in one place. Mural Pay
  gives you full control over your balances with instant access whenever you need to move money.**
* ### **Send**
  
  **Move money across borders to anyone, anywhere, in their preferred currency. Mural Pay
  streamlines every transfer with real-time tracking and fast settlement, so your recipients get
  paid without the wait.**
* ### **Receive**
  
  **Accept payments from anywhere in the world with dedicated accounts. Mural Pay handles routing
  and FX complexity so funds land in your account ready to use. Seamlessly accept stablecoins now.**
* ### **Convert**
  
  **Swap between currencies at market-leading rates with full transparency. Mural Pay shows you
  exactly what you're getting before you confirm, without hidden fees.**
* ### **Earn**
  
  **Put idle balances to work. Mural Pay lets you generate yield on stored funds, turning dormant
  cash into passive income.**
* ### **Comply**
  
  **Enable global financial workflows without having to acquire licensing or build your own
  compliance program. Mural Pay automates compliance checks and regulatory reporting so you can
  focus on growing your business.**

[iGB Affiliate Barcelona 2026]
iGB Affiliate Barcelona 2026

**Spain, Barcelona** – 20-21 January

At iGB Affiliate Barcelona, we spent most of our time with marketing networks, media buyers, and
affiliates, who all run into the same problem: paying partners across borders without delays. We
showed how our system handles mass payouts, sending funds to hundreds of partners at once instead of
processing them one by one.

 

[G Gate Conf 2026]
G Gate Conf 2026

**Georgia, Tbilisi** – 26-27 June

We closed out the first half of the year at G Gate Conf in Tbilisi, meeting regional tech companies
and e-commerce platforms. Several were still running on bank transfers and manual invoicing, so we
walked them through what it takes to add crypto payments without rebuilding their existing setup.

[ICE Barcelona 2026]
ICE Barcelona 2026

**Spain, Barcelona** – 19-21 January

ICE is one of the largest B2B tech exhibitions in the industry, and we used it to introduce our
multi-chain payment infrastructure to enterprise platforms and software providers. Most questions
were about network fees: how our flat-fee model on TRC20 and batch transaction processing cut down
costs, and what that means for a platform's margins.

[MAC Affiliate Conference 2026]
MAC Affiliate Conference 2026

**Armenia, Yerevan** – 26-27 May

Many of the conversations at MAC came back to volatility: merchants get paid in crypto but don't
want to depend on the exchange rate. Our instant conversion tools lock in the price at the moment of
payment, so the business is no longer exposed to rate swings. 

[iFX EXPO Dubai 2026]
iFX EXPO Dubai 2026

**UAE, Dubai** – 10-12 February

At iFX EXPO Dubai, we talked with institutional brokers, liquidity providers, and fintech brands
about our payment infrastructure. Most of the interest was around integration: how a platform can
add crypto payment flows directly to its own website without redirecting users elsewhere.

[SiGMA Rome 2025]
SiGMA Rome 2025

**Italy, Rome** – 4-6 November

At SiGMA Rome, we met with European fintech companies, digital merchants, and regulators. Most
conversations at our booth came back to processing: invoicing that's easy to set up, withdrawals
that run automatically, and an analytics dashboard that shows exactly where fees go.

[SIGMA Eurasia 2026]
SIGMA Eurasia 2026

**UAE, Dubai **– 10-11 February

We had an official booth at SiGMA Eurasia 2026, one of the fastest-growing fintech events in the
region. Investors, e-commerce founders, and brand owners stopped by, and most were surprised at how
quickly they could open a business account and start accepting crypto payments.

The digital B2B payment network for agentic finance — where money settles in real time and fees fall
as you grow.

## How much money could you save with Paystand?

[Book a demo][182] today to get a custom ROI analysis.

**ZEROTOUCH**

## **Accounts Receivable that Runs Itself **

Your finance team didn't sign up to chase invoices or reconcile deposits by hand. So Paystand runs
the whole cycle on one network. AI-native collection plans that pull cash in faster. A
custom-branded portal that makes paying effortless. Cash and deposit that apply and reconcile
themselves to the GL and entity. A digital analyst that reports, forecasts cash, and sees the
shortfall before it lands. Your team sets the strategy. The network does the rest.

[Hero section 2]

**ZEROFEES · B2B PAYMENTS
**

## **The Only Zero-Fee B2B Payments Network
## **

On Paystand, money moves at the speed of software — instant and global on the network, free on the
rails we own. Card, ACH, check, cross-border — every way in, one network. Funds are verified at the
bank the moment your customer pays, so the money's real before you ship and compliant by design.
Transparent for your customer. Automated for you. Profitable for both. You set the policy, and you
save more as your volume grows.

[The Only Zero-Fee B2B Payments Solution]

**ZEROTIME · GET PAID FASTER**

## **Put Collections on Auto-Pilot. DSO Drops 40%.**

AI-native collection plans, tuned on how millions of businesses actually pay and get paid, pull cash
in faster. Reporting and cash forecasting that flag the shortfall before it lands — available to you
in seconds. No delayed deposits. No manual cash application. Just real-time visibility and cash in
the bank sooner.

[Instant Access to Your Cash or Stop Paying to Get Paid]

**JOURNEY TO 100% · ACCOUNTS PAYABLE**

## **Spend, Governed by a Digital Agent
## **

You set the rules once. A digital agent works right inside Slack or Teams — requests come in, get
checked against your policy, and route for approval without anyone leaving the conversation.
Receipts captured, transactions coded, the month-end close shortened. No chasing and no spend
slipping past policy. Finance keeps control. Everyone else keeps moving. Capital stewarded, not just
spent.

[Accounting-automation_header]

## **Finance Operations, Running in Real Time 
## **


Most finance stacks are a pile of tools that don't talk — a processor, a reconciliation bolt-on, an
AP app, each with its own fees and gaps. Paystand replaces the bolt-ons and supercharges the systems
you keep — your ERP, your bank, your workflows — connecting money in, money out, and reconciliation
on one network governed by your policy. Not a rip-and-replace. An upgrade. Cost falls as you grow.
Manual work disappears. Finance runs strategy, not data entry.

# Vendors get paid the way they want.

Plastiq gives you the flexibility to pay by credit card — even when your vendors don’t accept them.
Plastiq sends your payments to your vendor as a domestic or international wire,  same-day ACH
transfer, or overnight check — all in one place.

[ Get Started ][55]
[ Watch Video ][56]
[ Get Started For Free ][57]

### How it Works

#### Simplify your invoices & extend cash flow at same time

Your vendors get paid on time, the way they get paid today. You can leverage your existing cards,
short-term financing, or link your bank account to defer repayment to the last minute or your next
card statement

[person making cash payment icon]

###### Add your vendors.

Through integrations with accounting tools like QuickBooks Online, uploading your invoices,
utilizing Plastiq’s robust vendor network — tell us who you’d like to pay.

[Pay How You Like]

###### Pay how you want

Pay by credit card, bank account, or even get access to short-term financing — Plastiq gives you the
flexibility to use whatever payment method you prefer.

[Saving Wallet International by Streamlinehq]

###### Pay your vendor how they prefer.

Choose your vendor’s prefer delivery method and send your payment by paper check, ACH, or wire — you
can even send payments with same day delivery or internationally.

#### Same day delivery available

Plastiq can deliver your payment as fast as you need it. With optional same-day ACH transfers,
overnight checks, international and domestic wires sent same day — Plastiq has you covered.
[Delivery Methods]

#### Extend your cash flow

Plastiq makes sure that your vendors get paid on time — while you get the benefit of extended cash
flow. Use your card to extend repayment to your next billing cycle.
[Delivery Calendar]

#### Reconciliation made easy

Syncing directly to Quickbooks Online, Sage Intaact, Oracle Netsuite, and Xero — Plastiq will make
sure you don’t end up with duplicate entries or manual updates. You can keep your Bills, vendors,
and payments completely in sync.
[Reconcillation]

#### You’re always in control

With roles and approval permissions you can make sure that your approval practices are carried out
digitally. Always be in the know when it comes to your businesses finances.
[Persmissions]
[double check mark icon]

###### No subscription fees

Plastiq accounts and access to all of the amazing features is completely free. You only pay the fees
associated with sending payments.
[Learn more][58]
[monitor download icon]

###### Automated bill capture

You can email, sync, or upload bills to Plastiq and we will automatically scan and enter all of the
payment details for you.
[Learn more][59]
[international wallet icon]

###### International payments

Send payments to 45+ countries in 20+ currencies. Choose between same or next day transfers and get
sharable SWIFT and FedWire numbers to keep you in the know.
[Learn more][60]
[locked shield icon]

###### Keep your finances secure

Plastiq uses world class security practices and by sending checks through Plastiq you can make sure
your bank account information never makes it into the wrong hands.
[Learn more][61]
[track-funds-mobile]

###### Plastiq on the go

With the Plastiq mobile app available on both iOS and Google Play, you are never more than a tap
away from your financial pulse.

# Pay by credit card.
# Vendors get paid the way they want.

Plastiq gives you the flexibility to pay by credit card — even when your vendors don’t accept them.
Plastiq sends your payments to your vendor as a domestic or international wire,  same-day ACH
transfer, or overnight check — all in one place.

[ Get Started ][55]
[ Watch Video ][56]
[ Get Started For Free ][57]
[HeroComp-updated]

### How it Works

#### Simplify your invoices & extend cash flow at same time

Your vendors get paid on time, the way they get paid today. You can leverage your existing cards,
short-term financing, or link your bank account to defer repayment to the last minute or your next
card statement

[person making cash payment icon]

###### Add your vendors.

Through integrations with accounting tools like QuickBooks Online, uploading your invoices,
utilizing Plastiq’s robust vendor network — tell us who you’d like to pay.

[Pay How You Like]

###### Pay how you want

Pay by credit card, bank account, or even get access to short-term financing — Plastiq gives you the
flexibility to use whatever payment method you prefer.

[Saving Wallet International by Streamlinehq]

###### Pay your vendor how they prefer.

Choose your vendor’s prefer delivery method and send your payment by paper check, ACH, or wire — you
can even send payments with same day delivery or internationally.

#### Same day delivery available

Plastiq can deliver your payment as fast as you need it. With optional same-day ACH transfers,
overnight checks, international and domestic wires sent same day — Plastiq has you covered.
[Delivery Methods]

#### Extend your cash flow

Plastiq makes sure that your vendors get paid on time — while you get the benefit of extended cash
flow. Use your card to extend repayment to your next billing cycle.
[Delivery Calendar]

#### Reconciliation made easy

Syncing directly to Quickbooks Online, Sage Intaact, Oracle Netsuite, and Xero — Plastiq will make
sure you don’t end up with duplicate entries or manual updates. You can keep your Bills, vendors,
and payments completely in sync.
[Reconcillation]

#### You’re always in control

With roles and approval permissions you can make sure that your approval practices are carried out
digitally. Always be in the know when it comes to your businesses finances.
[Persmissions]
[double check mark icon]

###### No subscription fees

Plastiq accounts and access to all of the amazing features is completely free. You only pay the fees
associated with sending payments.
[Learn more][58]
[monitor download icon]

###### Automated bill capture

You can email, sync, or upload bills to Plastiq and we will automatically scan and enter all of the
payment details for you.
[Learn more][59]
[international wallet icon]

###### International payments

Send payments to 45+ countries in 20+ currencies. Choose between same or next day transfers and get
sharable SWIFT and FedWire numbers to keep you in the know.
[Learn more][60]
[locked shield icon]

###### Keep your finances secure

Plastiq uses world class security practices and by sending checks through Plastiq you can make sure
your bank account information never makes it into the wrong hands.
[Learn more][61]
[track-funds-mobile]

###### Plastiq on the go

With the Plastiq mobile app available on both iOS and Google Play, you are never more than a tap
away from your financial pulse.   
[Learn more][62]
[certified-ribbon-rating-icon]

###### Earn rewards

## WE BELIEVE THAT TECH EDUCATION IS FOR EVERYONE!

## **Unlock Your Potential with Accredited Online Training Courses**

Staying ahead in today’s fast-paced and highly competitive world requires more than just talent—it
requires continuous learning and professional growth. That’s why we’re committed to helping
individuals and organizations succeed through **Professional Training** programs designed for
real-world results.

Whether you're just starting your career or seeking to level up your current skills, our platform
offers a comprehensive range of **Accredited Online Training Courses** tailored to your goals. From
technical studies and business management to IT skills and software development, we deliver
world-class learning experiences at your fingertips. Our training partners are Top Tier including:
Microsoft, Google, Oracle, Cisco, Cambridge, NPTEL amongst others.

### 🎯 **Why Choose Our Online Professional Training Platform?**

Our vision is simple: to empower learners through **flexible, high-quality, and industry-relevant
training**. We understand that every learner is different, which is why we offer self-paced,
instructor-led, and hybrid formats that adapt to your schedule and learning style.

Our catalog of **Professional Development Courses Online** is designed by industry experts,
certified trainers, and thought leaders across various fields. Each course is built to equip you
with in-demand skills that employers value most in today's dynamic marketplace.

Whether you're a student, job seeker, entrepreneur, or working professional, we have a course that
fits your path to success.

We are committed to bridging the gap between education and employability. Our programs combine
practical, industry-driven learning with international accreditation, making our certifications
relevant across borders.
* Relevant skills education focused
* Internationally accredited certifications (ACTD-US & QAHE-UK)
* Flexible online learning programs
* Career-focused curriculum designed for today’s workforce
* Trainers from multiple countries and industries


### 🎓 **Explore Our Certificate Courses Online**

Earn recognized credentials that showcase your skills and commitment to continuous improvement. Our
**Certificate Courses Online** are not only accessible from anywhere in the world but are also
aligned with global standards and frameworks. Each certificate adds credibility to your resume and
opens doors to new opportunities across industries such as:
* Information Technology & Cybersecurity
* Digital Marketing & eCommerce
* Business Management & Leadership
* Data Analysis & Artificial Intelligence
* Human Resources & Project Management
* Software, IT & Programming

By enrolling in our certificate programs, you gain more than just knowledge—you gain an edge in the
job market.

### 📈 **Advance Your Career with Professional Development Courses Online**

Our **Professional Development Courses Online** are strategically designed to meet the evolving
needs of both individuals and organizations. Whether you're looking to upskill in your current role,
make a career switch, or enhance your business performance, our training modules are built for
transformation.

With real-world case studies, live coaching sessions, hands-on projects, and interactive
assignments, you’ll develop not just theoretical knowledge but also practical expertise. We also
provide career support resources including CV optimization, job search tips, and interview coaching
to help you take the next step confidently.

### 🏆 **Trusted by Thousands, Backed by Results**

What sets us apart is our commitment to quality and learner satisfaction. Our platform has helped
thousands of learners achieve their professional and personal goals through our **Accredited Online
Training Courses**. We combine modern technology with proven teaching methodologies to ensure each
learner experiences measurable growth.

Join a vibrant learning community, access on-demand support, and benefit from a dynamic learning
environment that evolves with you.

### 🚀 **Start Your Journey Today**

The future belongs to those who are prepared. Don’t wait for opportunities—create them with our
expertly crafted **Professional Training** programs. Explore our **Certificate Courses Online**,
enroll in high-impact **Professional Development Courses Online**, and discover why our platform
offers some of the **Best Online Training Courses** available today.

Your path to success is just a click away. Start learning, start growing, and start leading.
